# Consolidated Financial Results for FY2026

Bluefield Instruments Inc.

Release date: May 12, 2026

Reporting period: April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2026

Earnings call: March 25, 2026 (online)

## 1 Results for the year

Consolidated results for FY2025 are shown below.

(In millions of US dollars)

| Item | FY2025 | FY2026 | Change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Net sales | 1,200 | 1,320 | +12.0% |
| Operating profit | 84 | 96 | +14.3% |
| Profit before tax | 80 | 92 | +15.0% |
| Net profit | 52,000 | 60,000 | +15.4% |
| Operating margin | 7.0% | 8.0% | — |

## 2 Overview

At Bluefield Instruments Inc., sales of measuring equipment for factories grew, and sales and every level of profit were higher than in the previous year. Parts cost more, and more efficient production made up for it.

## 3 Dividends

The annual dividend is $0.30 a share, up from $0.25 in the previous year.

## 4 Outlook

For FY2027, we expect net sales of $1,400 million and operating profit of $105 million.
